description.value: Cit-E Cycles Bridge Street is a full-service e-bike shop and retailer near Victoria's Inner Harbour, part of a six-location BC chain that claims Canada's largest e-bike selection with 195+ models from brands including Cube, Aventon, and Tern. The store sits at Bridge and Gorge, adjacent to the Galloping Goose Trail and well-positioned for the Lochside Trail corridor running north to Sidney and the Swartz Bay ferry terminal — making it a practical stop for cyclists arriving from or departing to the Gulf Islands. Certified technicians handle everything from tune-ups to major diagnostics, and walk-in test rides are available on any in-stock model.
